wooBatch.comment: Woo disclosure batch (case, status, deck board, document assessment refs) - admin-only workflow storage, provisioned so /woo has a real register/schema to resolve against

wooAssessment.comment: Per-document Woo openbaarheid assessment (weigeringsgronden, redaction, anonymized document) - admin-only workflow storage

wooBatch.title: WooBatch
wooBatch.summary: A Woo disclosure batch grouping the documents released for one Woo-verzoek case
wooBatch.description: A Woo disclosure batch represents one Woo-verzoek (Wet open overheid request) case moving through document collection, per-document assessment, review and publication to the public reading room. It is the OpenRegister-backed storage WooService reads and writes; the document queue itself is provisioned as a Deck board via the consumed deck leaf (ADR-022) rather than a bespoke queue table.

caseReference.description: The Procest Woo-verzoek case reference this batch belongs to
caseReference.title: Case Reference

title.title: Title
title.description: The title the publication gets. Without one it is named after the case reference.

wooCategory.title: Woo information category
wooCategory.description: The information category the publication is filed under. Without one it is filed under Woo requests and decisions.

x-enum-labels.infocat003: Draft legislation sent out for advice
x-enum-labels.infocat007: Meeting documents of the States General
x-enum-labels.infocat008: Meeting documents of local and regional governments
x-enum-labels.infocat009: Agendas and decision lists of executive boards
x-enum-labels.infocat013: Subsidy obligations other than by decision

status.description: Batch lifecycle status, moved only through the declared transitions: submit (in_progress to ready_for_review), approve (ready_for_review to approved, behind the batchReview approval chain), reject (ready_for_review back to in_progress, with a reason) and publish (approved to published).
status.title: Status

deckBoardId.description: The Deck board id provisioned (or re-used) for this batch's document queue
deckBoardId.title: Deck Board ID

deckAvailable.description: Whether the Deck app was available when this batch was created; false means the document queue/board could not be provisioned
deckAvailable.title: Deck Available

documents.description: References to the document-assessment objects collected in this batch
documents.title: Documents

decisionLetter.description: The Woo decision letter (besluit) content or reference for this batch
decisionLetter.title: Decision Letter

inventoryList.description: The generated inventarislijst (document inventory list) content or reference for this batch
inventoryList.title: Inventarislijst

documentSummary.description: Derived per-status document assessment progress (counts, total, assessed, progress label); computed on read from the linked assessment objects, not independently authoritative storage
documentSummary.title: Document Summary

publishedAt.description: Timestamp the batch was published to the public reading room
publishedAt.title: Published At

publishedCount.description: Number of documents published to the reading room (openbaar + deels_openbaar assessments)
publishedCount.title: Published Count

wooPublication.description: The publication metadata recorded when this batch was published: decision date, request reference, category, document/published counts, besluit, inventarislijst, per-document listings and the reading-room URL
wooPublication.title: Woo Publication

updatedAt.description: Timestamp the batch was last updated
updatedAt.title: Updated At

createdBy.description: The user id that created this batch, or "system" when created without an active user session
createdBy.title: Created By

assignee.description: The user who has to act on the batch next. A rejection assigns the batch back to its author (createdBy).
assignee.title: Assignee

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the reviewer sent the batch back.

by.title: Rejected by
by.description: The user who rejected the batch.

rejections.description: Every rejection of the batch in review, oldest first: the reviewer's reason, who rejected it and when.
rejections.title: Rejections

lastRejectionReason.description: The reason of the most recent rejection, as the author's notification names it.
lastRejectionReason.title: Last rejection reason

previewsSeen.description: Per reviewer, the documents whose public view they opened during the review. Approve waits until the approving user opened every published document.
previewsSeen.title: Previews seen

wooAssessment.title: WooAssessment
wooAssessment.summary: A per-document openbaarheid assessment within a Woo disclosure batch
wooAssessment.description: A document-assessment object represents the openbaarheid (public disclosure) decision for a single document collected in a Woo disclosure batch: which weigeringsgronden (WOO Art. 5.1/5.2 refusal grounds) apply, any redaction instructions, and the resulting anonymized document when partially disclosed. Each assessment is linked to a Deck card via the consumed deck leaf so its status is reflected on the document queue board.

documentReference.description: Reference to the source document being assessed (id or path from the originating case system)
documentReference.title: Document Reference

fileName.description: The file name of the document being assessed
fileName.title: File Name

fileType.description: The file type (MIME type or extension) of the document being assessed
fileType.title: File Type

fileTypeClaimed.description: The file type the caller sent, kept when it differs from the type read from the stored bytes (published-file-carries-its-facts REQ-PFF-001). Empty when they agree.
fileTypeClaimed.title: File Type Claimed

assessment.description: The openbaarheid assessment decision for this document
assessment.title: Assessment

weigeringsgronden.description: Selected WOO Art. 5.1/5.2 refusal ground article references (required when the assessment is "niet_openbaar")
weigeringsgronden.title: Weigeringsgronden

groundsListVersion.description: The version of dossiq's refusal grounds list the codes in weigeringsgronden belong to. Set on every save; an assessment without it still carries OpenCatalogi's earlier codes, which the MapStoredRefusalGrounds repair step maps once.
groundsListVersion.title: Grounds list version

unmappedGrounds.description: Stored ground codes the repair step could not map unambiguously to dossiq's list. They are kept in weigeringsgronden as they were and listed here for an officer to settle.
unmappedGrounds.title: Unmapped grounds

redactionInstructions.description: Free-text redaction instructions for a partially-disclosed (deels_openbaar) document
redactionInstructions.title: Redaction Instructions

anonymizedDocument.description: Reference to the anonymized/redacted version of the document, used for deels_openbaar publication
anonymizedDocument.title: Anonymized Document

anonymizedDocumentHash.description: SHA-256 of the redacted file when it was verified. Publishing refuses a redacted file whose bytes changed since.
anonymizedDocumentHash.title: Redacted file checksum

redactionStatus.description: Whether a verified redacted version exists: verified, failed, or empty when the document is not partly public
redactionStatus.title: Redaction status

redactionMessage.description: Why the partly public document cannot be published yet
redactionMessage.title: Redaction message

redactionLog.description: What was removed from the partly public document and on which grounds, one entry per redacted passage. Internal: never part of a public response.

relationId.title: Relation
relationId.description: The OpenRegister entity relation the passage comes from.

entityType.title: Type
entityType.description: The kind of information that was removed, such as a name or a phone number.

positionStart.title: Start position
positionStart.description: Where the removed passage starts in the text.

positionEnd.title: End position
positionEnd.description: Where the removed passage ends in the text.

value.title: Removed value
value.description: What was removed. Internal: never part of a public response.

grounds.title: Grounds
grounds.description: The legal grounds for removing the passage.

redactionLog.title: Redaction log

caseReference.description: The Procest Woo-verzoek case reference this assessment belongs to
caseReference.title: Case Reference

assessedBy.description: The user id that made this assessment decision, or "system" when assessed without an active user session
assessedBy.title: Assessed By

assessedAt.description: Timestamp this assessment decision was made
assessedAt.title: Assessed At

titlePublic.description: Whether the title of this document may be shown on the public decision when the document is withheld.
titlePublic.title: Title public

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the reviewer sent the document back.

by.title: Sent back by
by.description: The user who sent the document back.

at.title: Sent back at
at.description: When the document was sent back.

sentBackReason.description: Why a reviewer sent this document back to assessment, who did and when. Internal: never part of a public response.
sentBackReason.title: Sent back reason
